## 简体中文

- 在管理页面新增独立的“Sempre 服务”标签，将系统服务的重启和停止操作从控制台设置中移入该标签。
- 新增一键检查更新：显示当前版本、最新稳定版本、发布时间和更新日志，并可直接升级已安装的 Sempre 系统服务。
- 更新元数据、安装器和升级下载统一通过 `sempre.run` 获取；客户端不再写死 GitHub 仓库地址，仓库迁移时只需更新站点侧元数据。
- Release 构建与 Pages 发布解耦：正式版完成自己的构建和发布后再触发稳定版 JSON 刷新，beta 版本不会进入稳定更新通道。
- 升级会短暂断开 Web 控制台；服务完成替换并重新启动后，重新连接即可确认新版本。

## English

- Added a dedicated “Sempre Service” tab in Management and moved system-service restart and stop actions out of the console settings tab.
- Added one-click update checks showing the current version, latest stable version, publication time, and release notes, with direct upgrades for installed Sempre system services.
- Routed update metadata, installers, and upgrade downloads through `sempre.run`; clients no longer hard-code the GitHub repository, so repository migrations only require a site-side metadata change.
- Decoupled release builds from Pages deployment: a stable release completes its own build and publication before triggering the stable JSON refresh, while beta releases stay out of the stable update channel.
- Upgrading briefly disconnects the Web console; reconnect after the service has replaced itself and restarted to confirm the new version.
